current_formulation: A fine-tuned local model expands a plain query into typed lex, vec, and hyde lines routed to their backends, and a caller may write the typed lines and an intent line directly.

steps.formulation: Release 0.6.0 (changelog date 2025-12-28) types the expansions as lexical, vector, and HyDE, so each goes to its own backend.
steps.quote: so each routes to the right backend instead of sending everything everywhere

steps.formulation: Release 0.8.0 replaces the stock expansion model with one fine-tuned by GRPO.
steps.quote: Fine-tuned query expansion model trained with GRPO replaces the stock Qwen3 0.6B.

criticism.quote: Eliminates ~4 wasted backend calls per query

steps.formulation: Release 0.9.0 (npm date 2026-02-15) keeps the type of each expansion on the way to the backends.
steps.quote: type-routed query expansion preserves lex/vec/hyde type info and routes to the appropriate backend

steps.formulation: Release 1.1.0 (relevant date 2026-02-20) lets the caller write a query document of typed lines instead of a plain query.
steps.quote: QMD queries are structured documents with typed sub-queries.

steps.formulation: Release 1.1.5 adds an intent parameter that steers expansion, chunk selection, reranking, and snippets.

criticism.quote: one reported query ran 23 expansions where 9 were distinct, and each copy ran its own search.
